packageRules.description: ESLint v10 is not compatible with the current frontend lint setup. Keep ESLint packages on v9 until the config is migrated.
CHUB's own image. A digest pin on our own :latest chases every merge to main forever (9 auto-merged bump PRs in 3 days). The compose example stays on bare :latest; do not pin or update it.

Python base image. A new 3.x is a minor update to Renovate, but it moves the site-packages path the Dockerfile copies and needs wheels for every dependency, so it broke the grouped non-major PR. Own PR, opened only when approved on the Dependency Dashboard.
